subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia's first thought upon entering the steam-filled corridor wasn't danger, it was assessment.
source_quote: my first thought wasn't danger, it was assessment

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia knows she rushed in.
source_quote: I know. I know I rushed in.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia believes the geometry of taking the hinge of the barricade was not impatience but strategy.
source_quote: That's not impatience. That's geometry.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia feels her ribs have opinions about how quickly they should move.
source_quote: My ribs had opinions about how quickly we should move.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia believes it is operational hygiene to exit the kill zone she created before it becomes indiscriminate.
source_quote: That's just operational hygiene.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer felt an animal want-to-be-elsewhere when confronting the wraith.
source_quote: Pure, animal want-to-be-elsewhere.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes St. Cuthbert does not permit elsewhere as a destination when undead are in the corridor.
source_quote: St. Cuthbert does not permit elsewhere as a destination when undead are in the corridor.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer realized his divine light had no effect on the wraith.
source_quote: The holy light dissolved into the cold air like breath in winter, leaving exactly nothing behind.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes the wraith's indifference is contemptuous.
source_quote: the cold contempt of its existence

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer hates the wraith for what it is and what it represents.
source_quote: I hate this thing. I hate what it is, what it represents

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer thought, 'This is not fair,' though he recognized it lacked theological dignity.
source_quote: This is not fair, I thought, which is not a thought with a great deal of theological dignity, but it was the honest one.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer refuses to believe he survived being killed and revived just to be mocked by an undead abomination.
source_quote: I did not survive all of that to be mocked by something that doesn't even have the decency to be alive when it defies me.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer intends not to be the one who dies today.
source_quote: But not me, I explained, to no one in particular, or possibly to St. Cuthbert directly, and I dashed.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes he is harder to hit than most due to his plate mail.
source_quote: I have good reason to believe I am harder to hit than most.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is haunted by the wraith laughing at him hysterically after his failed attempts.
source_quote: came the sound of the wraith laughing at me. *Hysterically.* It laughed at me *hysterically*.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes his divine power should have worked on the wraith by theological logic.
source_quote: the divine power of St. Cuthbert... that should by every measure of theological logic have worked today

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recognized the smell of ghouls before seeing them.
source_quote: The smell arrived before the sound. That sick, wet rot...

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr feels deeply unpleasant about ghouls being former Earth Temple members he knew.
source_quote: That was the worst part. Not strangers... People we'd seen in corridors, nodded to... Now raised...

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr believes the ghouls appearing in their territory was not part of the plan.
source_quote: Ghouls lurching into our territory... was not in the plan.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr has been paralyzed by ghouls before and has a personal interest in killing them first.
source_quote: I've been paralyzed by ghouls before (we all have, at this point)... so I have a very personal and practical interest in killing them first.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr wonders if Calmer's outburst is him or something else wearing his voice.
source_quote: is that him, or is that something else wearing his voice?

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr has filed away Zinnia's concern that Calmer is going native.
source_quote: the concern Zinnia had put into words once, something about Calmer going native, which I am choosing not to look at directly.

subject: Calmer's transformation
fact: Zephyr suspects Calmer's rage against undead may be something more than mere faith — possibly a change in his core identity.
source_quote: is that him, or is that something else wearing his voice?

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed that Calmer's divine power caused the ghouls to flee in terror.
source_quote: they fled. Not shambled. Not lurched. Fled in terror

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr observed Calmer cursing uncontrollably after unleashing his divine power.
source_quote: Calmer was going "yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!" The cursing started.

subject: Necromantic threat
fact: Zephyr suspects someone with necromantic power is using the corpses of Earth Temple members still within the dungeon.
source_quote: Someone with necromantic power was working in this dungeon right now, during our carefully engineered war, with access to our people's corpses and apparent interest in deploying them.
